title: Beyond the Mean Gap: What Transferred-Angle QAOA Retains on a Superconducting Processor
abstract: arXiv:2611.10529v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Hardware executions of the quantum approximate optimization algorithm (QAOA) are often validated by comparing the device's mean cost with a simulation, a check that can miss what matters for optimization. Under global depolarization, the mean normalized gap and the floor-corrected probability of every set of bitstrings, the optimum included, retain the same fraction of their noiseless improvement over uniform sampling. We test this prediction with depth-2, transferred-angle QAOA circuits for binary subproblems of an alternating-direction decomposition on the IBM Heron processor \texttt{ibm\_marrakesh}, with and without dynamical decoupling and twirling. At 12 qubits, the main-family circuits retained 29\% to 46\% of their mean-gap improvement but only 5\% to 15\% of their probability of the optimum, lower on at least nine of ten instances per run. translated_title: 超越平均间隙：转移角度QAOA在超导处理器上保留了什么
translated_abstract: 量子近似优化算法（QAOA）的硬件实验通常通过将设备的平均成本与模拟结果进行比较来验证，但这种检查方式可能会遗漏对优化真正重要的内容。本文证明，在全局去极化噪声下，平均归一化间隙以及每一组比特串（包括最优解在内）经基底校正后的概率，都会保留其相对于均匀采样无噪声改进的相同比例。研究团队在IBM Heron处理器ibm_marrakesh上，使用深度为2的转移角度QAOA电路测试了这一预测，所求解的是交替方向分解方法的二进制子问题，并分别在有和无动态解耦与twirling的条件下进行实验。在12个量子比特的规模下，主族电路保留了其平均间隙改进的29%到46%，但只保留了最优解概率的5%到15%，且在每次运行的十个实例中至少有九个实例表现更低。近优比特串的损失程度与最优解大致相当，而应避免……
tldr: 该研究发现在超导处理器上运行深度为2的转移角度QAOA时，12量子比特电路虽保留了29%–46%的平均间隙改进，但最优解概率仅保留5%–15%，表明仅靠平均成本对比验证硬件QAOA性能会掩盖对优化最关键的最优解概率的大幅损失。
en_tdlr: On a superconducting processor, depth-2 transferred-angle QAOA at 12 qubits retains 29–46% of its mean-gap improvement but only 5–15% of its optimal-solution probability, revealing that mean-cost validation misses what matters most for optimization.
